items.title: Bitcoin Rises, Crypto Miners Sharply Divided As Midterms Dampen AI Outlook
items.summary: Bitcoin price rises. Miners diverge sharply after midterm elections on AI, data center slowdown fears. Riot Platforms spikes on $28bil deal.

items.title: Coinbase Says 99% of Customer Crypto Is Offline and Out of Hackers’ Reach
items.summary: Coinbase told customers it wasn’t affected by the $6.4 billion Binance hack and detailed its security controls, including offline storage for over 99% of assets, split private keys and kill switches.

items.title: Bitcoin, XRP, crypto stocks surge after GOP loses midterm 2026
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to $75,618 after the midterms, below its $77,994 low after the Binance hack, but quickly recovered to $80,000.

items.title: Bitcoin Tops $81,000 After Midterm Dip, Squeezing Short Sellers
items.summary: Bitcoin slid to about $75,600 while the midterm results came in, then climbed past $81,000 on Wednesday, forcing out hundreds of millions of dollars in bets against crypto.

items.title: Circle Earnings Show Stablecoins Have Arrived. A Crypto Payoff Could Take Longer.
items.summary: Circle Internet stock rises as usage of its stablecoin, USDC, increased 8% from a year ago.

items.summary: A Second Circuit panel turned down the prediction-market companies' requests for interim relief in a two-page order on Tuesday that leaves their federal preemption argument unresolved.
